# esgleam · v1.0.0

Source: https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm/

# esgleam

*esbuild for Gleam that works on Erlang & JavaScript.*

-
Create a Gleam project as you would normally and make sure you have a file in `src`with the name of your project (as specified in`gleam.toml`)
-
Install `esbuild`

```
gleam run -m esgleam/install
```
```
gleam run -m esgleam/bundle
```
See `/dist` for your bundled code

- To start a development server

```
gleam run -m esgleam/serve
```

(Follow steps 1-2)

- Create `/src/build.gleam`with the following

```
import esgleam
pub fn main() {
   esgleam.new("./dist/static")
   |> esgleam.entry("main.gleam")
   |> esgleam.bundle
}
```
See [esgleam](https://hexdocs.pm/esgleam/esgleam.html) for all config options and their default values.

- Run your build script

```
gleam run -m build
```

### Install

Install esbuild.

```
gleam run -m esgleam/install
```
### Bundle

Bundle the project into a library with `src/{project_name}.gleam` as your entry point and `./dist/{project_name}.js` as your output file.

```
gleam run -m esgleam/bundle
```
### App

Bundle the project into a single file to run with `src/{project_name}.gleam` as your entry point and `./dist/{project_name}.js` as your output file.
Similar to just running `gleam run`.

```
gleam run -m esgleam/app
```
### Serve

Starts a dev server, serving the `dist` directory as `/`.

```
gleam run -m esgleam/serve
```

If available on Hex this package can be added to your Gleam project:

```
gleam add esgleam
```
and its documentation can be found at [https://hexdocs.pm/esgleam](https://hexdocs.pm/esgleam).

## Roadmap

-
Create file watcher for `*.gleam`which runs on both Erlang and JavaScript
-
Fix bug with STDOUT/STDERR not being shown when running `esbuild`in the erlang target
- Write tests for config options
- Add more config options if needed
-
Pseudo-SourceMaps until [#1341](https://github.com/gleam-lang/gleam/discussions/1341)merges
- Consider creating a way to use plugins
- Hot Module Reloading?????

---

# esgleam · v1.0.0

Source: https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm/index.html

# esgleam

*esbuild for Gleam that works on Erlang & JavaScript.*

# esgleam · esgleam · v1.0.0

Source: https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm/esgleam.html

Config for esbuild

```
pub type Config {
  Config(
    autoinstall: Bool,
    outdir: String,
    entry_points: List(String),
    format:
```
[Format](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Format),
    kind: [Kind](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Kind),
    minify: Bool,
    target: List(String),
    serve: [option.Option](https://hexdocs.pm/gleam_stdlib/0.65.0/gleam/option.html#Option)(String),
    sourcemap: Bool,
    platform: [option.Option](https://hexdocs.pm/gleam_stdlib/0.65.0/gleam/option.html#Option)([Platform](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Platform)),
    watch: Bool,
    raw: String,
  )
}### Constructors

-
          `Config( autoinstall: Bool, outdir: String, entry_points: List(String), format:`[Format](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Format), kind:[Kind](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Kind), minify: Bool, target: List(String), serve:[option.Option](https://hexdocs.pm/gleam_stdlib/0.65.0/gleam/option.html#Option)(String), sourcemap: Bool, platform:[option.Option](https://hexdocs.pm/gleam_stdlib/0.65.0/gleam/option.html#Option)([Platform](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Platform)), watch: Bool, raw: String, )#### Arguments- autoinstall
-
                If true, automatically install esbuild if has not been installed (needs Erlang installed) default `True`.
- outdir
-
                Output directory
- entry_points
-
                List of entry points supplied
- format
-
                Output format for JavaScript. See `Format``Esm`
- kind
-
                Kind for output default `Library`
- minify
-
                default `False`
- target
-
                List of [target environments](https://esbuild.github.io/api/#target)default`[]`
- serve
-
                The root directory for the dev server (run server when defined) default `None`
- sourcemap
-
                Generate sourcemap for JavaScript default `False`
- platform
-
                Platform for the output See [esbuild/platform](https://esbuild.github.io/api/#platform)for what each type does default`Neutral`
- watch
-
                Enable watchmode. Bundles files on change Note: `gleam build`need to be run manually default`False`
- raw
-
                raw flags to pass to esbuild default `""`

Output format of generated JavaScript

```
pub type Format {
  Esm
  Cjs
  Iife
}
```
### Constructors

-
          `Esm`ECMAScript module
-
          `Cjs`CommonJS
-
          `Iife`immediately-invoked function expression

Kind of output

```
pub type Kind {
  Script
  Library
}
```
### Constructors

-
          `Script`Executes the `main()`function in your entry point
-
          `Library`Only exports the code

`pub fn autoinstall(config: `[Config](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Config), do_install: Bool) -> [Config](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Config)Boolean for autoinstalling esbuild if it is not found.
If `True`, requires erlang to be install on the system.

`pub fn bundle(config: `[Config](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Config)) -> Result(Result(Nil, a), String)Executes `esbuild` with the provided config parsed as CLI arguments.

`pub fn new(outdir path: String) -> `[Config](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Config)Start to create a build script

```
> esbuild.new("./dist/static")
Config("./dist/static", ...)
```
```
pub fn platform(
  config:
```
[Config](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Config),
  platform platform: [Platform](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Platform),
) -> [Config](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Config)Generate code for a specified platform

`pub fn serve(config: `[Config](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Config), dir path: String) -> [Config](https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm#Config)Start a development server on http://127.0.0.1:8000 with `path` being `/`

# esgleam/app · esgleam · v1.0.0

Source: https://esgleam.hexdocs.pm/esgleam/app.html

`pub fn main() -> Result(Result(Nil, a), String)`

    Bundles `gleam.main.mjs` as a script using ESM to the `./dist` directory.

Will run the main function in %{project_name}.gleam
